verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is an offline one-time-passcode generator. Its only user data is TOTP/HOTP secrets, which it stores, syncs and displays as codes. AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data are outside what this kind of product does, and nothing in the evidence shows any AI or insight feature that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
